svg.text: Velocity / Layering Dwell-Time & Dispersion Exposure Analytics Pattern
Detects funds that clear onto and off an account almost immediately -- in fast, out faster, spread wide.

g.text: Pacific Rim Commercial Bank - Summit Branch
funds clear in, clear out fast
• Funds clear out almost as fast as they arrive
• Turnover dwarfs the account's own balance
• Outbound leg spreads across many destinations
BA005 detects funds that clear onto and off an
account almost immediately. It quantifies the
dwell time and velocity relative to balance, the
corroborates the finding with a value-match
ratio -- how closely the outbound amount tracks
the inbound amount. Accounts that would
otherwise pass as ordinary conduits are surfaced.

svg.text: BUILDING THE FOUNDATION FOR NETWORK INTELLIGENCE AND GRAPH-BASED FINANCIAL CRIME INVESTIGATIONS
